name: What's the difference between a contractor-coordinated installation and buying a tub and hiring trades yourself?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a contractor-coordinated installation and buying a tub and hiring trades yourself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Opting for a contractor-coordinated installation means a single entity manages all aspects: sourcing the tub (if desired), hiring and scheduling specialized trades like plumbers and electricians, obtaining permits, and overseeing the entire project. This simplifies the process for you, ensures accountability, and minimizes potential delays or conflicts between different workers. When you buy a tub and hire trades yourself, you become the project manager, responsible for finding reliable professionals, coordinating their schedules, ensuring work meets code, and resolving any issues that arise. The contractor-coordinated approach offers convenience and peace of mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: A contractor-coordinated installation provides a single point of contact and manages all project aspects, whereas self-coordination means you manage trades and permits yourself.
